findings.description: Documents filed with the planning department propose invoking the city's Family Zoning Plan to raise the mixed-use building under construction here from four floors to six, doubling residential capacity from 18 to 36 units. The approved project already under construction is a four-storey mixed-use infill over a two-storey basement garage, with 50 car and 49 bicycle spaces, 9,980 sq ft of dentist's office and 6,560 sq ft of ground-floor retail on a 0.33-acre lot between Locust and Spruce. The filing is a project review meeting request, not a preliminary or formal application. Gary Gee Architects is the project architect and ShoreCal Engineering drafted the updated floor plans; Litke Properties is the property owner and Sacramento Locust Associates the sponsor. The building is not finished, so none of this goes in the page's building block.

extra.stage: project review meeting request; not a formal application

findings.description: Permit activity has resumed on a dormant nine-storey proposal for this half-acre surface parking lot between 16th and 17th Streets, now pursued by a joint venture of DM Development and Thompson Builders, which aims to start construction in autumn 2026. The plan approved in April 2021 is a 107-foot building of 154,400 sq ft — 132,350 sq ft residential, 1,340 sq ft ground-floor retail and nearly 14,000 sq ft of stacker garage for 47 cars — holding 168 apartments (64 studios, 37 one-bedrooms, 67 two-bedrooms), 31 of them affordable. Handel Architects designed the approved scheme. Nothing is built here, so none of this goes in the page's building block.

extra.stage: approved 2021; permit activity resumed, construction targeted for autumn 2026
